exactText: I believe that we’re only a few years away from that, maybe 2030, plus or minus a year—which is astounding to think, really.
sourceQuote: I believe that we’re only a few years away from that, maybe 2030, plus or minus a year
normalizedClaim: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) will be achieved around 2030, plus or minus one year.
resolutionCriteria: Consensus declaration by major AI labs (DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) or independent evaluators that a system has achieved AGI-level performance across a broad range of cognitive tasks by end of 2031.

exactText: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a system that exhibits all the cognitive capabilities the brain has, is probably only a few short years away.
sourceQuote: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a system that exhibits all the cognitive capabilities the brain has, is probably only a few short years away.
normalizedClaim: AGI is probably only a few short years away from being achieved.
resolutionCriteria: Public demonstration or formal claim by DeepMind/Alphabet or peer consensus of a system matching human-level cognitive capabilities across domains by 2030.

exactText: When we look back on this time in the decades to come, I think we will realise we were standing in the foothills of the singularity - nothing less than the dawning of a new age for humanity.
sourceQuote: we will realise we were standing in the foothills of the singularity
normalizedClaim: Looking back from future decades, 2026 will be recognized as the foothills of the technological singularity.
resolutionCriteria: Retrospective assessments by AI researchers and historians around 2035–2040 describing the mid-2020s as the onset of the singularity or equivalent transformative period.

exactText: The magnitude of this technology’s impact will be unprecedented, perhaps 10x of the Industrial Revolution at 10x the speed.
sourceQuote: perhaps 10x of the Industrial Revolution at 10x the speed.
normalizedClaim: The impact of AGI will be approximately 10 times that of the Industrial Revolution and will occur at 10 times the speed.
resolutionCriteria: Historical and economic analyses comparing the scale and pace of societal/economic transformation from AGI (once achieved) versus the Industrial Revolution, published by major research institutions by 2040.

exactText: You can imagine the agentic era in this next year is a little bit like a practice run.
sourceQuote: the agentic era in this next year is a little bit like a practice run
normalizedClaim: The wave of AI agents in the following year (2026–2027) will serve as a societal practice run for more powerful AGI systems.
resolutionCriteria: Observable widespread deployment and societal stress-testing of advanced AI agents during 2026–2027, followed by significantly more capable systems, as documented in industry reports and public incidents.

exactText: Train a would-be AGI on physics up to 1901, then see if it can come up with the same insights and discoveries that Albert Einstein began publishing in 1905.
sourceQuote: Train a would-be AGI on physics up to 1901, then see if it can come up with the same insights and discoveries that Albert Einstein began publishing in 1905.
normalizedClaim: A true AGI should be able to rediscover Einstein-level insights when trained only on physics knowledge available up to 1901.
resolutionCriteria: Successful demonstration of an AI system generating novel scientific insights equivalent to Einstein’s 1905 papers when restricted to pre-1905 training data, published or verified by DeepMind or independent evaluators.

exactText: It is much more akin to the discovery of electricity or fire.
sourceQuote: It is much more akin to the discovery of electricity or fire.
normalizedClaim: The impact of AGI will be more comparable to the discovery of electricity or fire than to prior digital technologies such as the internet.
resolutionCriteria: Long-term historical and societal impact assessments (post-AGI) ranking AGI’s transformative effect alongside foundational discoveries like fire or electricity rather than incremental tech advances.

exactText: It’s going to effectively be a new human era.
sourceQuote: It’s going to effectively be a new human era.
normalizedClaim: The arrival of AGI will effectively inaugurate a new era for humanity.
resolutionCriteria: Widespread cultural, economic, and scientific recognition by 2035 that the post-AGI period constitutes a distinct new era of human civilization.

exactText: Society needs to hear that because we don't have long to prepare for what that means.
sourceQuote: we don't have long to prepare for what that means.
normalizedClaim: Society has only a short remaining window (a few years) to prepare for the arrival and implications of AGI.
resolutionCriteria: Whether major governmental and institutional preparedness frameworks for AGI-level systems are substantially advanced or still lagging by the time AGI is widely acknowledged (target resolution around 2030–2031).

exactText: something like 10 times the impact of the industrial revolution, and 10 times faster
sourceQuote: something like 10 times the impact of the industrial revolution, and 10 times faster
normalizedClaim: AGI will deliver roughly 10 times the impact of the Industrial Revolution and arrive 10 times faster.
resolutionCriteria: Quantitative and qualitative historical comparisons of economic productivity growth, scientific output, and societal change rates in the decade following AGI versus the Industrial Revolution century, published by economic historians or major think tanks by 2040.
